verdict.rationale: Instinct is itself an autonomous personal assistant that users text or call to delegate tasks such as booking rides, appointments, travel, purchases and follow-ups across connected email, calendar and devices. Multiple hands-on testers confirm it completes delegated tasks end-to-end, including phone calls, reservations, inbox cleanup and podcast booking follow-ups, and it also acts proactively, though reports of unasked-for actions, wrong bookings and credential friction show its reliability is uneven. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of delegation capabilities (the public surface is only a homepage and legal pages), and consistent reliability on delegated actions.
